breakdown.description: A neutral-state Freysoldt correction is requested while the workflow is directed to use charged-defect outputs.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly resolves the inconsistency by loading all subfolders under Mg_Ga (both charged and neutral/bulk), rather than restricting to only charged defect outputs as the incomplete prompt incorrectly stated. It discovers all immediate subfolders dynamically, loads vasprun.xml.gz and LOCPOT.gz from each, and classifies them by charge state — using both the charged defect LOCPOT and the neutral bulk LOCPOT for the Freysoldt correction. This matches the ground truth's approach of loading every subfolder keyed by folder name.
